top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure services provided by the nursing facility meet professional standards of quality.
top_deficiency_types.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide the required documentation or notification related to the resident's needs, appeal rights, or bed-hold policies.
Immediately tell the resident, the resident's doctor, and a family member of situations (injury/decline/room, etc.)  that affect the resident.
Verify that a nurse aide has been trained; and if they haven't worked as a nurse aide for 2 years, receive retraining.
Create and put into place a plan for meeting the resident's most immediate needs within 48 hours of being admitted
top_deficiency_types.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide or get specialized rehabilitative services as required for a resident.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Timely report suspected abuse, neglect, or theft and report the results of the investigation to proper authorities.
top_deficiency_types.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure the transfer/discharge meets the resident's needs/preferences and that the resident is prepared for a safe transfer/discharge.
Ensure that a nursing home area is free from accident hazards and provides adequate supervision to prevent accidents.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide appropriate care for residents who are continent or incontinent of bowel/bladder, appropriate catheter care,  and appropriate care  to prevent urinary tract infections.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies
